newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Jan 15 date set for Argentine Pichi Picun dam sale.
newsitem.headline: Jan 15 date set for Argentine Pichi Picun dam sale.

text.p: The deadline for bids in the privatization of Argentina's Pichi Picun Leufu hydroelectric dam has been extended until January 15, the government said Friday.

"The postponement is due to serious concerns presented by firms that bought the bid specifications, and since all parties want a successful sale, we decided to delay," said a spokesman from the government's Energy Secretariat.
The sale was due to go ahead on December 20. This is the fifth postponement.

Under the new schedule, companies bidding have to present the technical aspects of their offers on January 15. Successful bidders will then go on to present the financial details of their offers on January 28, when the winner will be announced.
Companies that have bought the tender specifications for the 261 MW dam in Neuquen province include Argentine firms Capex SA, Perez Companc SA and Hidroelectrica El Chocon SA.
AES Corp and Entergy of the U.S. have also bought the specifications.
